verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents built-in LLM functions that include SQL generation (docs-75), and in-product Dives turn natural-language prompts into dashboards that you refine conversationally (docs-4, docs-23). Guides supply schema and metric context so agents produce accurate SQL (docs-30). The remote MCP server is aimed at external agents, so it is not an in-product assistant. missing for 10: evidence of an in-product assistant that fixes SQL errors, evidence that it explains SQL, detail on how SQL generation grounds itself in user schemas, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
